headline.text: Lennar's delivery cut puts its favorable seasonal record in perspective

preview.text: Lennar reduced its delivery outlook after September 16 earnings.

How much reassurance can the seasonal record offer? This article's long study covers October 5, 2026-January 8, 2027. Nine of 10 matching windows starting in selected midterm-election years from 1986 through 2022 gained, versus 50.0% of consecutive windows starting in 2016-2025. The latest matched window, October 5, 2022-January 8, 2023, finished 19.92% higher but also moved 12.04% below its starting price. Those extremes do not reveal which move came first. The complete article compares the supplied histories and explains why a profitable finish can still involve a difficult path. The overlapping histories do not provide independent confirmation.
